plan.summary:
The cache size can now be set with the `CACHE_MB` environment variable.

- `cacheConfig` parses `env.CACHE_MB` as a number.
- It uses the parsed value only when it is finite and greater than zero.
- Otherwise it uses `DEFAULT_MEGABYTES`, as before.
plan.riskRationale: Small, local config change with a safe fallback to the default. No auth, data, or API contract changes.
plan.storyArc: One change: the cache size comes from `CACHE_MB` when the value is valid. Invalid or missing values keep the old default.

topics.title: Read cache size from CACHE_MB with a safe fallback
topics.narrativeBrief: How does `cacheConfig` choose the cache size now, and which inputs fall back to the default? Verify in the source that an unset variable gives `Number(undefined)`, which is NaN, so the default is used.
